title: Trapped in a neighborhood while being hunted by someone
content: Does this happen to anyone else? I am always in a neighborhood that I don’t recognize and I have the awareness that someone is trying to kill me. I spend the entirety of some dreams hiding in houses that I’ve never seen before, trying to find a place where I won’t be found. I usually end up hiding in the most ridiculous places, like hide and seek with a 4 year old
